svg.aria-label: A slab cache: pages from the buddy allocator, cut into objects of one size
svg.title: A slab cache: pages from the buddy allocator, cut into objects of one size
svg.text: A slab cache: pages from the buddy allocator, cut into objects of one size
cache “dentry”: objects of 192 bytes, 21 per slab, one slab = one 4 KiB page (order 0)
Each CPU takes objects from its own slab, without a lock, and refills it from the partial slabs.
The free objects of a slab are chained by a pointer stored inside them (arrows in CPU 0's slab).
buddy allocator: free blocks of 2^k pages
caches of larger objects take larger slabs (ext4_inode_cache: 1.1 KiB objects, 14 per 16 KiB slab)
a new slab when no free object is left
an empty slab is given back
No search, no external fragmentation inside a slab, and a freed object is soon reused, often still in the CPU cache.
